singleJudge.finding: [native] The Restore after operations and Include prerelease check boxes are 16 x 16 px (y 12 to 27) where the design system requires 18 x 18, as the row check boxes in the same capture are drawn.
[native] The gear and refresh glyphs peak at the muted #9d9d9d (the secondary-text colour) where the artboard's icon.foreground glyphs reach #cccccc, so the header actions read as dimmed or disabled.
[native] The details placeholder is centred horizontally at the top of the pane (x 518 to 744), where a workbench welcome-style empty state is left-aligned with 20 px side padding.

[native] The list pane paints #181818 (sideBar.background), as the design system's colour-role table assigns the list pane, while the artboard draws it in the same #1f1f1f as the details pane; the drawing and the rule disagree.
[states] The project and source selects show a heavy, small filled-looking browser-default arrow; the artboard draws the thin chevron-down codicon in both selects.

[states] The fallback package icon is a saturated orange cube on this row and most others; the artboard draws Newtonsoft.Json with a monochrome package glyph on a neutral tile, so the column uses colour as decoration against the artboard element.
[states] The author text is regular weight (Serilog Contributors here, and every row); the artboard draws the unselected Serilog row's author at the 11/600 emphasis.
[states] On the preview row the long version string pushes the author down to a bare ellipsis after the Verified mark, so the row loses the authors that the two-line Installed anatomy shows.

[states] The checkbox label reads "Include prerelease", in both the capture and the artboard, while the microcopy list spells the word "Pre-Release" in labels and "pre-release" in sentences (Design System section 10, item 7).
[native] The Vulnerable label badge on the selected row has a small corner radius, where the Modern UI label badge is a pill.
[native] The Restore and Prerelease check boxes are 16 px square, where the artboard and the workbench check box are 18 px.
[native] The trash glyph on the selected row is muted grey (#9d9d9d), where the artboard's row-action-uninstall is white in list.activeSelectionIconForeground.

[native] Rows without a package icon of their own show an orange box glyph, where the artboard draws a muted codicon package on a neutral tile, so colour is used as decoration and the rows look unlike workbench icons.
[native] Authors on the rows are regular weight, where the artboard draws the author at 11/600.
[native] The words 'High severity' take the warning colour, where the colour roles give the severity colour to the glyph and text keeps the foreground role.
[geometry] The two details action rows are 6 px apart (Uninstall bottom y 132, Update and version selector top y 138) against the spec's 4 px gap (156.2 to 160.2).
[geometry] The header, tab-strip and details-strip lines paint #313131 where the rule's divider key and the artboard give #2b2b2b in Dark Modern, so the divider is not in its role.
[states] The dependency groups carry counts as "(N)" text, such as ".NETStandard1.3 (6)", while the same surface uses badges for counts, which breaks the one-count-style rule.

refuted.finding: Package names truncate at x 281 with about 36 px of empty row before the scrollbar at x 318, so the Microsoft.Extensions.* ids differ by only one visible letter; the unused space is given up before the name, unlike Extensions view rows.
refuted.reason: The name ends at about x 281, which is the redline's reserved action column (band end 318 minus end inset 6, action 22 and gap 8 gives 282; the spec's 327 band gives 291), and DS-ROW-5 is hard and green, so the space is declared and the truncated ids are live content.

refuted.finding: The list column below the header is painted #181818, a darker sidebar-like surface, where the artboard paints the list column in the same #1f1f1f as the details pane and the header, so the whole column has a different colour role from the artboard.
refuted.reason: The pane does read #181818, but the design system's colour-role table assigns the list pane sideBar.background, so the role is right and only the artboard drawing differs, which native-24 records as a minor conflict.

refuted.finding: The Installed tab carries a second, red-outlined badge "1" with no visible meaning beside its count badge; the artboard draws one count badge per tab and nothing in the spec declares a second one (it may follow from this workspace's vulnerable package, but its presence is not declared).
refuted.reason: The red-outlined '1' is visible, but it is live data from this workspace's vulnerable package (the artboard's workspace has none) and interaction model §3 specifies that the Installed tab shows the vulnerable count, so it is not an undeclared extra.

refuted.finding: The two lists under the details group headers use different indents: the Vulnerabilities warning glyph starts at x 457 and the Dependencies chevrons at x 450, both under headings at x 440.
refuted.reason: The offset is visible (warning glyph about x 457, chevrons about x 450), but these are two different components with no rule, artboard element or exemplar cited, so rubric §6 excludes it.
